content.outro: The first spadeful goes in. Nobody says anything after that.
content.premise: Oris Vane kept the sea wall. When the storm came he opened the sluice, and the harbour lived and the low fields drowned. Now he is dead, the burial road forks, and the village has four hands for a bier that wants six. You were hired for the other two.
content.theme: A funeral procession on a coast road that forks, and a village that cannot agree which ground the dead man belongs in.
content.title: The Wake
